gloss: to miss catching; to let escape; to fail to obtain

definitions.gloss: to miss catching; to let escape; to fail to seize
definitions.explanation: To fail to catch or capture something or someone that was within reach. Used for criminals, opportunities, and things one tried but failed to get.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}した。
⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}してしまった。
⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}さないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up early so as not to miss the limited-edition product.

notes:
Compound verb of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take, to catch) + ⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧ (to let escape, to miss). Godan verb conjugating on the す row. Implies that one had a chance to obtain or capture something but failed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}す: to let a criminal escape
- ⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}す: to miss an opportunity
- ⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}す: to let prey escape
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{逃|のが}す: to let victory slip away

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss, to let escape (simpler; the base verb)
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}す→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧: to overlook, to miss seeing
- ⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧: to miss (a vehicle — train, bus)
